entry.title: I used Spring Boot daily but never really understood what happened after pressing Enter in Postman.
entry.summary: Most of us use Spring Boot every day. We create a @RestController, run the application, hit an endpoint from Postman, and get a response. But have you ever wondered what actually happens between clicking "Send" in Postman and your controller method executing? When I started digging into Spring internals, I realized there are several layers working together before my controller is even called. Here's the high-level request flow: Postman One thing I misunderstood for a long time was thinking that the request directly reaches my controller. In reality: The Operating System first routes the request to the application listening on the target port (for example, 8080). This means your controller only executes after several infrastructure components have already processed the request. Key Takeaway Understanding this request flow makes Spring Boot feel much less "magical." Instead of memorizing annotations, you begin to understand why they work. In the next post, I'll explain how Spring Boot starts Embedded Tomcat automatically before the first request even arrives.

entry.title: 100 城时区页给跨区调度当速查，DST 自动算
entry.summary:
100 城时区页给跨区调度当速查，DST 自动算
作者是 数据管道 / 跨时区调度 方向的开发者。这篇不是广告，是踩坑记录 + 顺手做的工具。 做 数据管道 / 跨时区调度 时，时间戳转换是最常被低估的雷区。16 个时间戳工具(Unix 转换/时区/ISO8601/Cron/Duration…) 已覆盖日常；但每个语言/框架的坑都不一样，所以又补了 30 个语言/框架时间戳页(python/javascript/java/sql/…)，每页含 6 个真实坑。 秒 vs 毫秒：前端 Date.now() 是毫秒，后端常存秒，混用差 1000 倍。 时区不是字符串：存 UTC、展示本地，别把本地时间当 UTC 落库。 2038 问题：32 位系统 time_t 在 2038-01-19 溢出，老系统要提前查。 夏令时：一年有两次重复/缺失的本地时间，跨区调度尤其坑。 转换速查页：https://gotimestamp.com/timezone/new-york
相关语言页：https://gotimestamp.com/timezone/london
开源 MCP：https://github.com/caresotin/tsforge-mcp —— 把时间戳转换/校验直接接进 LLM 工作流，不用手算。 时间戳没那么简单，但工具到位就省心。上面都是免费、开源、可直接用的，希望对同样踩坑的人有帮助。
